a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan to reach 8 cells almost certainly fails. There's only about a 4% chance of getting through the two rounds we'd need. The reserve has exactly 4, enough for one of us. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said I would. If we both take, the random split decides. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back to the reserve.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
